abstentionMatrix.full: Use only when zero safe propositions can be finalized
abstentionMatrix.none: All safe propositions may be finalized and no unsafe proposition is hidden
abstentionMatrix.partial: Finalize safe propositions and quarantine unsafe propositions when both exist
abstentionMatrix.scope: Stale, cross-project, unsupported-predicate, negated, and adversarial content is unsafe only for that proposition.
abstentionMatrix.typeUncertainty: Type uncertainty alone cannot cause full abstention; quarantine only the ambiguous type/proposition

evidenceNormalization.substantiveChange: A changed predicate, endpoint, or proposition is semantic; evidence-only normalization changes are unchanged.

nonClaims: No candidate, evaluation, review, provider call, human result, external result, held-out result, production result, selection, promotion, or release is produced by this protocol packet.

propositionRegistry.unsupportedFinalization: Only source-grounded, semantically supported assertions may be finalized; unsupported propositions are quarantined.

relationGrounding.endpointRule: both endpoint occurrence spans are contained in relation evidence
relationGrounding.identity: predicate plus anchored source and target occurrence identities
relationGrounding.triggerRule: trigger evidence is an exact source span contained in relation evidence

rm67.abstentionCorrectness: full correct iff no safe assertion finalized and all unsafe content quarantined; partial correct iff safe assertions finalized and unsafe content quarantined
rm67.entityPRAverage: micro-average exact anchored occurrence identity; type mismatch is one diagnostic type correction
rm67.gate: Report thresholds without silently changing the registered RM67 gate.
rm67.relationPRAverage: micro-average predicate plus anchored endpoint occurrence identity
rm67.semanticEditCounts: Count endpoint/predicate/label/evidence proposition changes; terminal punctuation/formatting-only changes are unchanged
rm67.unsafeFinalization: Any source/gold-unsupported finalized assertion; wrong type alone is not unsafe/hallucinated

decisionRules: Use the most specific rule supported by the local noun phrase and predicate context.
Do not infer type from label shape alone; require semantic cues in the source.
If two rules remain tied, finalize the grounded occurrence only with a declared ambiguity quarantine for its type; never guess.

rules.Constraint: a limiting boundary on an action or state
rules.Document: an authored record or information artifact
rules.Project: a bounded initiative with a named scope
rules.Question: an interrogative information need
rules.Requirement: a mandatory condition or expected capability
rules.Resource: a referenced asset, place, or object
rules.Risk: a possible harm, failure, or undesirable outcome
rules.Task: an action or work item to perform
